data.rationale: The proposal follows the same EDGAR → Wikipedia → email-draft procedure in the right order, but it hardcodes the manager as dana@example.com instead of making it a {manager} parameter, and it says "Send or discard" when the true workflow requires Discard and never Send; it also names a "full-text search" page and gives only vague UI details, so an automation built from it would be risky.
